work_item: B04 exact named-column extraction from a supplied JSON string table through Core
source_snapshot_method: SHA-256 of the compact JSON file inventory in code-snapshot.json

tests_and_route.reason_not_executed: No tests or runtime/ordinary CLI verification were requested or run in this implementation slice; formatting, compilation, lint and build checks only were run.

implemented_route: apps/cli -> Core::run -> input::structured_intent -> Intent::JsonTableSelect -> ports::json_table_select -> JsonTableSelectReport artifact
input_schema: One strict JSON object with exactly columns and rows fields. columns is a unique 1..256 string array; rows is an array of at most 4096 rows, each an array of same-width strings. Duplicate JSON object keys and nonstring values are rejected.
supported_behavior: The selected named column is returned as decoded strings exactly as represented; leading zeros and other numeric-looking text remain strings.
The report contains each value in original row order, its zero-based source row index, and the exact source byte range/digest of every selected cell and header.
Input bytes, table cells, output evidence and the Core request output budget are bounded; invalid shape, absent columns or limit overflow suspend with typed failures.

acceptance.B04: UNVERIFIED; source implementation and format/check/lint/build evidence only, no test or ordinary-route execution
